person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified NARA row preserves the unusual printed form Francis. Jr. with middle initial J and civilian grade Caf-5. Exact-name and normalized-name searches produced no source that links a Francis J. Acosta Jr. to this grade, OSS service, an archival identifier, or a pre-OSS employer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 2 to establish Francis J. Acosta Jr.'s full identity, the meaning and dates of the Caf-5 appointment, occupation, and recruitment chronology. Preserve the printed punctuation while checking the normalized variants. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The NARA Pfc row is visually verified. Exact-name OSS, Army, employment, obituary, institutional, CIA Reading Room, and Library of Congress searches did not locate a corroborating unit, hometown, archival identifier, occupation, or employer for Gilmore J. Acosta.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 2 for Gilmore J. Acosta's full identity, Army unit or specialty, occupation, and OSS recruitment or transfer chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

Acree records are chronologically incompatible or lack corroborating identifiers.

Compare the Virginia Tech class-of-1942 lead only if the file supplies corroborating education or hometown evidence. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
